en.headline: Police treat death of elderly woman in Kai Tak as murder, arrest Indonesian helper
en.dek: A woman in her nineties was found unresponsive at De Lang Estate on Sunday morning and later died in hospital; police arrested the Indonesian domestic helper and are investigating as murder.
body: Police said a woman in her nineties was found unresponsive at a flat in De Yao House of De Lang Estate in Ngau Tau Kok on Sunday morning and later died after being taken to hospital.
Officers arrested an Indonesian domestic helper on suspicion of involvement. The case is being treated as murder and is being handled by the serious crime unit of Sau Mau Ping police district.
Police said they would hold a press briefing on Monday afternoon to outline further details of the investigation. The woman had been living at the estate and was being cared for by the helper.
No further information on the exact circumstances has been released pending the briefing and forensic examination.

zh.headline: 啟德德朗邨九旬婦不治 警列謀殺案拘捕印傭
zh.dek: 一名九旬婦人周日早上在牛頭角德朗邨德瑤樓被發現失去知覺，送院後不治；警方拘捕印尼籍女傭，案件列作謀殺跟進。
body: 警方表示，周日上午一名九旬婦人在牛頭角德朗邨德瑤樓單位內被發現失去知覺，其後送院搶救不治。
警方已拘捕一名印尼籍家庭傭工，案件列作謀殺，由秀茂坪警區重案組跟進。
警方指，將於周一下午舉行記者會交代進一步案情。該婦人居於該屋苑，由有關傭工照顧。
在記者會及法醫檢驗完成前，詳細經過仍未公布。
